rules.sentence: B-symptoms are seen in less than 20% of patients and should prompt consideration for transformation into DLBCL.[10]
The lymph node involvement is not in an orderly manner, and early hematogenous dissemination is common.

Presenting symptoms related to the sites of involvement (stomach, lung, ocular adnexa, breast, thyroid, bowel, skin, and soft tissue) and B-symptoms are rare and should raise suspicion for transformed lymphoma.
